caption: The drawing depicts a brown metal watering can with a round lid and a small knob on top, a long, straight spout extending to the left, and a curved handle on the right side. The body of the can features a circular decorative panel in the center, containing an illustration of two red apples, green leaves, and branches against a light greenish-beige background. The can is shaded to give it a three-dimensional appearance, and the artist's signature, "Richard Taylor," appears in black ink in the lower right corner of the image. The background of the drawing is an off-white or light beige color with no additional objects or designs.
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
